title: Repair a reversal
prompt: Reverse values in place: change the array you are given, and return nothing. Do the swaps yourself.
hints: Trace the starter on [1, 2, 3]. What happens to the pair at positions 0 and 2 the second time it is reached?
Each pair must be swapped exactly once. Stop when the two positions meet.
Loop while index is less than its mirror position, or use left and right pointers with while (left < right).

rules.name: reverse
rules.message: Write the swaps yourself. Do not call reverse.

checkLabels: One element stays where it is.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Swaps every pair twice, which puts each element back.
Calls the built-in method instead of practising the swaps.

feedback: Write down which pairs of positions are swapped for a three-element array. Each pair should appear once.
